def.era.medieval.name: Middle Ages
def.era.medieval.desc: Villages of wood and stone, tilled fields and dirt roads.
def.material.soil.name: soil
def.material.soil.desc: Soft ground that is easy to dig.
def.material.granite.name: granite
def.material.granite.desc: Very hard, tough rock, slow to dig.
def.material.limestone.name: limestone
def.material.limestone.desc: Pale, soft rock, good for building.
def.material.sandstone.name: sandstone
def.material.sandstone.desc: Compacted sand rock, easy to work.
def.plant.oak.name: {count, plural, one {oak} other {oaks}}
def.plant.oak.desc: A sturdy tree of hard wood.
def.plant.pine.name: {count, plural, one {pine} other {pines}}
def.plant.pine.desc: A tall softwood tree that grows on the slopes.
def.plant.berry_bush.name: {count, plural, one {berry bush} other {berry bushes}}
def.plant.berry_bush.desc: Bears edible berries; it fruits again a few days after picking.
def.item.log.name: {count, plural, one {log} other {logs}}
def.item.stone.name: {count, plural, one {stone} other {stones}}
def.item.stone.desc: Loose stone left over from digging rock.
def.item.berries.name: {count, plural, one {berry} other {berries}}
def.item.berries.desc: Wild fruit. Not very filling, but better than nothing.
def.item.provisions.name: {count, plural, one {ration of provisions} other {rations of provisions}}
def.item.provisions.desc: Hard bread, cheese and dried meat for the first days.
def.need.hunger.name: hunger
def.need.hunger.desc: Without food, a settler grows weak and eventually dies.
def.need.rest.name: rest
def.need.rest.desc: A tired settler sleeps wherever they can.
def.creature.human.name: {count, plural, one {human} other {humans}}

def.work_type.mining.desc: Digging out walls and opening stairs down.

def.work_type.gathering.name: gathering
